tools.name: search-flight
tools.title: Search for flights with Kiwi.com
tools.description:
# Search for flights

Searches Kiwi.com for available flights between two locations for the given dates and passengers. City or airport names are resolved automatically, so call this whenever the user wants to search for flights — whether they gave IATA codes or just place names.

## Result shape

Returns `{ query, currency, passengers, resultsCount, itineraries, searchTimeMs }`. Each item in `itineraries` has:
- `price` (number) and `priceFormatted` (e.g. "123 EUR")
- `totalDurationSeconds`
- `bookingUrl` — the link to book the flight
- `imageId` — destination city id for a hero photo (https://images.kiwi.com/photos/600x600/{imageId}.jpg)
- `baggage` — total included baggage across all travelers: `{ personalItem, cabinBag, checkedBag }` (counts)
- `outbound` (and `inbound` for return flights), each a leg with: `route` (list of airport codes including layovers, e.g. ["PRG","MAD","BCN"]), `departureTime` / `arrivalTime` (local ISO timestamps), `durationSeconds`, `stops`, `cabinClass`, and a `segments` list. Each segment has `from`/`to` (IATA), `fromCity`/`toCity`, `fromName`/`toName` (full airport names), `fromCountry`/`toCountry`, `carrier` (code) and `carrierName` (airline name), `flightNumber`, and `cabinClass`.

## How to display

Render a markdown table. Group results into cheapest (lowest `price`), shortest (lowest `totalDurationSeconds`), and other notable options. For each itinerary show, in order:
  - Route: join `outbound.route` with " → " (e.g. "PRG → MAD → BCN"); for return flights show `inbound.route` on a second line.
  - Times & duration: `outbound.departureTime` → `outbound.arrivalTime` (local), formatted readably (e.g. "12 Jun 06:05 → 09:30 (3h 25m)") using `outbound.durationSeconds`; add the `inbound` equivalents for return flights.
  - Cabin: `outbound.cabinClass` (e.g. "Economy").
  - Price: `priceFormatted`.
  - Booking link: `bookingUrl`.

Finally, summarise the best price and the shortest option, give a recommendation, and end wishing the user a nice trip with a short fun fact about the destination!

tools.name: feedback-to-devs
tools.title: Send Feedback to Developers
tools.description: Send feedback, bug reports, or feature requests about the Kiwi.com flight search MCP tools on this server to their developers. This channel is ONLY for the flight search tools — search results, pricing, itineraries, filters, or errors in search responses. Do NOT use it for other MCP servers, Claude/app behaviour, account or booking management, voice mode, or unrelated Kiwi.com features; those won't reach the right team. Include error messages, logs, or context that would help the developers reproduce the issue.

text.description: The content of the feedback. Include error messages, logs, or context that would help the developers reproduce the issue.

tools.name: trivago-accommodation-radius-search
tools.title: Search hotels near a location on trivago
tools.description: PREFERRED way to search hotels. Search live hotel and accommodation listings around coordinates — the center of a city, a neighborhood, a landmark, an address, or a venue — aggregated via trivago's metasearch of major booking sites. Returns the same, filterable results as trivago-accommodation-search. Before calling, resolve the latitude and longitude of the place the user wants to stay in yourself (e.g. Berlin → 52.52, 13.405). Use it for every city, neighborhood, or landmark search, including plain requests like "hotels in Paris". Use trivago-accommodation-search only for one specific property by name, or for a region or country too large for one point.

latitude.description: Latitude of the place the user wants to stay near: the center of the city or neighborhood, or the landmark, address, or venue. Resolve it yourself; not the user's own location.

longitude.description: Longitude of the place the user wants to stay near: the center of the city or neighborhood, or the landmark, address, or venue. Resolve it yourself; not the user's own location.

arrival.description: The arrival date in YYYY-MM-DD format. It must be today or in the future and MUST be before the departure date. If the arrival date is not in the future, notify the user that the arrival date is not in the future.

departure.description: The departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format. It MUST be after the arrival date. If the departure date is not after the arrival date, notify the user that the departure date is not after the arrival date.

children_ages.description: Dashed separated list of children ages, e.g. 10-12-14

rooms.description: The number of rooms, Number of rooms must be lower than or equal to the number of adults

country.description: The user's own market as an ISO alpha-2 country code: where the user lives or browses from, NOT the destination's country. It determines market-specific pricing and content. Use ONLY one of the listed values; if the user's country is not listed, pick the closest listed market (same region or language). Omit it when you know nothing about the user. Default: US.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency the user wants to see prices in: the one they ask for, or else the currency of their own country, NOT the destination's unless the user asks for it. Use ONLY one of the listed values; if the user's currency is not listed, pick the closest listed one (the most used currency in their region, else USD or EUR). Omit it when you know nothing about the user. Default: USD.

language.description: Language for translated content: the language the user writes in. Their country only picks the regional variant, never the language (e.g. a German speaker in Switzerland → DE_CH, an English speaker in Germany → EN_GB or EN_US, not DE_DE). Use ONLY one of the listed values, written exactly as listed (e.g. EN_US, DE_DE, ZH_HANS_CN), never a tag such as "en" or "en-US". If there is no exact match, pick the closest listed value: the same language in another region (e.g. Canadian French → FR_FR), else EN_US. Default: EN_US.

freeCancellation.description: Whether the accommodation has free cancellation

freeWiFi.description: Whether the accommodation has free WiFi

gym.description: Whether the accommodation has a gym

kitchen.description: Whether the accommodation has a kitchen

petFriendly.description: Whether the accommodation is pet friendly

pool.description: Whether the accommodation has a pool

spa.description: Whether the accommodation has a spa

filters.description: The filters that you want to apply to the search. Set true or false for each filter. Multiple filters can be selected.

rating70.description: Whether the accommodation has a Guest Rating of 7.0+

rating75.description: Whether the accommodation has a Guest Rating of 7.5+

rating80.description: Whether the accommodation has a Guest Rating of 8.0+

rating85.description: Whether the accommodation has a Guest Rating of 8.5+

review_rating.description: The guest review rating that you want to filter by. Set true or false for each rating. Multiple ratings can be selected.

1star.description: Whether the accommodation has a 1 star rating

2star.description: Whether the accommodation has a 2 star rating

3star.description: Whether the accommodation has a 3 star rating

4star.description: Whether the accommodation has a 4 star rating

5star.description: Whether the accommodation has a 5 star rating

hotel_rating.description: The hotel rating that you want to filter by. Set true or false for each rating. Multiple ratings can be selected.

budgetType.description: Whether minPrice/maxPrice apply per night (PRICE_PER_NIGHT) or for the whole stay (PRICE_PER_STAY). Defaults to PRICE_PER_NIGHT when a price is given but this is omitted.

maxPrice.description: Maximum price, in major units of the resolved currency (e.g. 150 for $150). Omit for no maximum.

minPrice.description: Minimum price, in major units of the resolved currency (e.g. 50 for $50). Omit for no minimum.

price_range.description: Optional price filter. minPrice/maxPrice are in major units of the resolved currency (e.g. 100 for $100). When both are given, minPrice must be strictly less than maxPrice. budgetType (PRICE_PER_NIGHT or PRICE_PER_STAY) chooses whether the bounds apply per night or for the whole stay, and defaults to PRICE_PER_NIGHT.

tools.description: Search live hotel and accommodation listings by name or free text, aggregated via trivago's metasearch of major booking sites. tools.name: trivago-destination-price-trends
tools.title: Forecast hotel prices on trivago
tools.description: Forecast monthly hotel price trends for a destination — average, minimum, and maximum nightly rate by star rating, across a date window. Use for planning questions like "when is the cheapest month to visit X" or "how do prices change through the year" — this is a forecasting tool, not a live-availability search.

query.description:
Destination query. Accepts two formats:
- Free-text destination name, e.g. "Berlin", "Paris", "New York".
- Coordinate pair in the format lat:<latitude>,long:<longitude>, e.g. "lat:52.52,long:13.405". The nearest destination to those coordinates is used. Latitude must be in [-90, 90] and longitude in [-180, 180].

start_month.description: Optional start year-month in YYYY-MM format (e.g. 2026-06). When omitted, the bridge defaults to the current month plus the next two months. It must be set when end_month is set.

end_month.description: Optional end year-month in YYYY-MM format (e.g. 2026-12). Must not be before start_month. Requires start_month to also be set.

country.description: The user's own market as an ISO alpha-2 country code: where the user lives or browses from, NOT the destination's country. It determines market-specific pricing and content. Use ONLY one of the listed values; if the user's country is not listed, pick the closest listed market (same region or language). Omit it when you know nothing about the user. Default: US.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency the user wants to see prices in: the one they ask for, or else the currency of their own country, NOT the destination's unless the user asks for it. Use ONLY one of the listed values; if the user's currency is not listed, pick the closest listed one (the most used currency in their region, else USD or EUR). Omit it when you know nothing about the user. Default: USD.

language.description: Language for translated content: the language the user writes in. Their country only picks the regional variant, never the language (e.g. a German speaker in Switzerland → DE_CH, an English speaker in Germany → EN_GB or EN_US, not DE_DE). Use ONLY one of the listed values, written exactly as listed (e.g. EN_US, DE_DE, ZH_HANS_CN), never a tag such as "en" or "en-US". If there is no exact match, pick the closest listed value: the same language in another region (e.g. Canadian French → FR_FR), else EN_US. Default: EN_US.

3star.description: Include 3-star hotels in the price statistics

4star.description: Include 4-star hotels in the price statistics

5star.description: Include 5-star hotels in the price statistics

hotel_rating.description: The hotel star ratings to include in the price statistics. Only 3, 4, and 5-star hotels are supported — forecasted price statistics are not available for 1 or 2-star hotels. Set true or false for each rating. Multiple ratings can be selected. When no rating is selected, the results default to 3-star hotels only.

monthly_prices.description: Monthly price statistics for this destination, ordered by month.

month.description: Year and month in YYYY-MM format.
